use_case_summary: Primary: real-time driver routing assistant (chat-like) with short prompts and frequent context updates. Secondary: enterprise search via embeddings and reranking for manifest lookup. Require deterministic latency under load and routable fallback to smaller quantized models for burst protection.
poc_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Dedicated staging cluster with 4x A40-equivalent GPUs. Run representative 72-hour soak test + scheduled peak-hour spikes. Phase 2 (1 week): Scale to production reserved plan (8 GPUs) for throughput verification. Deliverables: latency distribution CSVs, token-cost estimate, failure modes, recommended reserve size, SLA draft.
load_test_profile:
- Baseline traffic: 1.5k concurrent active sessions; average 0.8 requests/sec per session
- Peak spikes: 3.5k concurrent sessions for 15 minutes every hour (simulate dispatch surge)
- Payloads: 40-120 token prompts (median 64), 1K batched embedding requests hourly
latency_targets:
- Median token latency <= 150ms for interactive prompts under baseline load
- P95 latency <= 400ms under baseline
- P99 <= 1s during controlled spikes
throughput_targets:
- Sustained throughput: 200 tokens/sec per GPU (conservative) to achieve 3k concurrent sessions target
- Burst capacity: autoscale >2x baseline within 60s or fallback to quantized variant
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial reserved commit recommendation: 8 GPUs (NVIDIA A40 / equivalent) with policy for 2 GPU burst buffer. Recommend mixed model variants: full FP16 replicas for latency-critical routes, 4-bit quantized for reranking and cost-tolerant workloads.
sla_negotiation_points:
- Target uptime SLA: 99.9% monthly for dedicated capacity
- Latency SLOs with crediting mechanism if P95 exceeds threshold
- Clear fallbacks (model variant routing) and defined maintenance windows
- Support: 24/7 on-call for incidents impacting reserved capacity
poc_observations:
- Early soak showed steady median latency ~140ms on staging at baseline; P95 spiked to ~520ms during synthetic network jitter tests.
- KV cache warmup improved tail latencies after 10 minutes workload steady-state.
- Autoscaling policy needs tuning; current cooldown led to dropped tokens during the first managed spike.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: corporate egress rule blocks fallback to hosted model variants. Mitigation: propose private-region fallback pools inside their VPC.
- Risk: SOC2 docs not yet accepted by security. Mitigation: provide third-party SOC2 report and customer-facing runbook; propose isolated test environment for security review.
